cards.name: Mystery Van
cards.text: Pay 1 Will: create a Sandwich token.

cards.name: The Unmasked
cards.text: Once per turn, when a Trap Relic you control makes an opponent Hold, deal 1 damage to their Icon.
cards.quote: And I would have, if not for you meddlers.

cards.name: Cowardly Detective
cards.text: When this Holds, you may Doubleteam 1 on your next Press this Clash.

cards.name: Hungry Hound
cards.text: Pay 1 Will, sacrifice a Food token: this gets +2 Strike this Clash.

cards.name: Brainy Sidekick
cards.text: Pay 1 Will: Mend 1. If you control a Clue token, Mend 2 instead.
cards.quote: This footprint is a size twelve.

cards.name: Fashion Scout
cards.text: While this has a Bond, it has +1 Guard.
cards.quote: My outfit is not a clue.

cards.name: Fearless Leader
cards.text: Aggression while you control two or more Food tokens.

cards.name: Diner Cook
cards.text: Start of your turn: create a Sandwich token.
cards.quote: You want fries with the mystery?

cards.name: Night Watchman
cards.text: Hold: the next Press against you this Clash ignores 1 Strike.

cards.name: Fake Ghoul
cards.text: Aftereffect: if the target Held, deal 1 extra.
cards.quote: The costume shop receipt is in the van.

cards.name: Trap Setter
cards.text: When you play a Relic, you may give it Toll 1 until your next turn.

cards.name: Van Driver
cards.text: Still. After this Presses, it still counts as Holding.

cards.name: Gossip Waitress
cards.text: Pay 1 Will: List.

cards.name: Rubber Bat Handler
cards.text: When this Presses, create a Rubber Bat token.
cards.quote: They are not real. They still count.

cards.name: Meddling Kid
cards.text: Once per turn, when a Trap Relic triggers, draw 1.
cards.quote: We would have gotten away with it.

cards.name: Groundskeeper
cards.text: Toll 1.

cards.name: Carnival Bouncer
cards.text: HeavyHitter.

cards.name: Jazz DJ
cards.text: Pay 1 Will: target Companion Holds this Clash. Mend 1.
cards.quote: This one goes out to the ghost.

cards.name: Swamp Actor
cards.text: When this Holds, create a Sheet Ghost token.

cards.name: Hall Monitor
cards.text: Opponents cannot Doubleteam against this.
cards.quote: No running in the haunted hall.

cards.name: Short Order Hero
cards.text: Sacrifice a Food token: this has Aggression this Clash.

cards.name: Clue Hound
cards.text: When you create a Food token, create a Clue token.

cards.name: Rubber Floor
cards.text: The first Companion that Presses each Clash must Hold instead. Trap.

cards.name: Painting Eyes
cards.text: Opposing Companions have Toll 1. Trap.

cards.name: Trapdoor
cards.text: Pay 2 Will: target Companion Holds and you create a Clue token. Trap.
cards.quote: It was under the rug the whole time.

cards.name: Pull Rope
cards.text: When a Companion you control Holds, deal 1 to a Pressing opponent. Trap.

cards.name: Creaky Stairs
cards.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Companion, you may draw 1 then discard 1.

cards.name: Projector Ghost
cards.text: Pay 1 Will: create a Sheet Ghost token.
cards.quote: The reel is in the attic.

cards.name: Lava Lamp Fog
cards.text: Your Food tokens have Closed.

cards.name: Wood Panel Door
cards.text: Sealed while you control a Trap.

cards.name: Diner Bell
cards.text: When you create a Food token, Mend 1 to your Icon.

cards.name: Shag Pit
cards.text: Companions that Press you get -1 Strike this Clash. Trap.
cards.quote: We found the remote and a ghoul.

cards.name: Fake Ghost Sheet
cards.text: Attach to Companion. Host has Closed.

cards.name: Medallion
cards.text: Attach to Icon. Host has Drain.
cards.quote: It came with the leisure suit.

cards.name: Bell Bottoms
cards.text: Attach to Companion. Host has Still.

cards.name: Snack Collar
cards.text: Attach to Companion. When host Presses, you may sacrifice a Food token to Mend 2.

cards.name: Magnifying Glass
cards.text: Attach to Companion. Host's Presses ignore 1 Guard.

cards.name: Walkie
cards.text: Attach to Companion. Host has Doubleteam 1.

cards.name: Flower Van Key
cards.text: Attach to Icon. Pay 1 Will: return target Companion you control to hand.

cards.name: Wax Mustache
cards.text: Attach to Companion. Host cannot be chosen as a Press target unless it Pressed this Clash.

cards.name: And I Would Have Gotten Away
cards.text: Now: Silence target Surge or activated spell. Draw 1.
cards.quote: If it were not for you meddling kids.

cards.name: Let's Split Up
cards.text: Now: target Companion you control has Doubleteam 1 this Clash.

cards.name: Jinkies
cards.text: Now: create a Clue token. Draw 1.

cards.name: Zoinks
cards.text: Now: return target Companion to its owner's hand.
cards.quote: I am too young for this haunted house.

cards.name: Hold The Door
cards.text: Now: target Companion Holds this Clash. It gets +2 Guard this Clash.
cards.quote: I have the handle. I think.

cards.name: Unmask
cards.text: Now: Remove target Companion if it has a Bond or is a Token.

cards.name: Snack Toss
cards.text: Now: create two Sandwich tokens.

cards.name: Trap Springs
cards.text: Now: target Pressing Companion Holds. Deal 2 to it.

cards.name: Lights On
cards.text: Now: destroy target Relic. Create a Clue token.

cards.name: Run To The Van
cards.text: Now: your Companions have Still this Clash. Mend 1 to your Icon.
cards.quote: She starts if you talk nice.

cards.name: Haunted Diner
cards.text: Rider only. Does not add Will. When you play this, create a Sandwich token.

cards.name: Carnival Lot
cards.text: Rider only. Does not add Will. Traps you control have Toll 1.

cards.name: Swamp Dock
cards.text: Rider only. Does not add Will. Your Tokens have +1 Guard.

cards.name: TV Station
cards.text: Rider only. Does not add Will. Once per turn, pay 1 Will: List.

cards.name: Sandwich
cards.text: Created by Mystery Van, Diner Cook, Snack Toss, Haunted Diner. Food. Vanishes when Removed. No Store value.

cards.name: Scooby Snack
cards.text: Food. When this is sacrificed, draw 1. Vanishes when Removed. No Store value.

cards.name: Rubber Bat
cards.text: Created by Rubber Bat Handler. Vanishes when Removed. No Store value.

cards.name: Clue
cards.text: Not a body. No S/G/H. Vanishes when Removed. No Store value.

cards.name: Sheet Ghost
cards.text: Created by Projector Ghost or Swamp Actor. Vanishes when Removed. No Store value.

cards.name: Pancake Stack
cards.text: Food. Vanishes when Removed. No Store value.
